pages.title: Bosses
pages.text: Several mods add big, named fights with their own arenas and unique drops. Most bosses are found in a dedicated structure or summoned with a special item. This page is the index; each mod has its own entry.

- [#](2E5AAC)[Cataclysm](entry://exploration/cataclysm)[#](): about a dozen bosses across all biomes.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Mowzie's Mobs](entry://exploration/mowzies_mobs)[#](): the Wroughtnaut, Umvuthi, Frostmaw and the Sculptor.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Twilight Forest](entry://exploration/twilight_forest)[#](): eight bosses with trophies.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Aquamirae](entry://ocean/aquamirae)[#](): the Ice Maze trio.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Pack tuning:** Cataclysm's main bosses and all four Mowzie's bosses have **0.7x health** and **0.75x damage**. They are softened, not removed, and every boss structure still generates.

Other bosses:

- [#](2E5AAC)[Aether](entry://exploration/aether)[#]() dungeons end in the Slider, Valkyrie Queen and Sun Spirit.
- Hybrid Aquatic has the Karkinos.
- [#](2E5AAC)[Iron's Spells](entry://exploration/magic)[#]() has the Dead King and a Citadel.
- Vanilla Wither, Dragon and Elder Guardian also remain.

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Tip:** boss drops often upgrade existing gear, so keep your best weapons around.\
\
In this pack the Cataclysm boss gear has Create-flavoured recipes: see [#](2E5AAC)[Cataclysm x Create](entry://exploration/cataclysm_create)[#]().

pages.title: Nether Star
pages.text: The Wither's drop goes into Create Nuclear's Reactor Controller and the [#](2E5AAC)[Stellar Core](entry://stars/stellar_core)[#]().
